rv.q: Slight musical from A Play, a Pie and a Pint about the women who loved Robert Burns
It’s rare, though, to encounter one that blazes with such a special energy as Nikolai Foster’s 2021. Leicester Curve production of A Chorus Line , playing at the Festival Theatre this week.

Despite never making himself seen on stage, Burns’ presence is nevertheless felt throughout the performance. Irene Allan , who plays Armour, brings Burns’ words to life and provides them with a newfound sensitivity as she wonderfully recites “Jean”, one of the beautiful poems which he wrote for his wife.
